build.description: Write the files generated from languages.config.cjs and queries/

generate.description: Write the generated files, then regenerate all five parsers
generate.command: deno task build && deno run --allow-read=. --allow-run=tree-sitter scripts/tree-sitter.ts generate

set-grammar-rev.description: Pin the commit Zed fetches the grammars from: deno task set-grammar-rev <sha>

fmt.description: Format TypeScript, JavaScript, JSON, Markdown and YAML, and the C scanner

lint.description: Lint with the recommended rules plus eqeqeq and asm/curly

check:generated.description: Fail if a generated file or parser is out of date
check:generated.command: deno run --allow-read=. scripts/build.ts check && deno run --allow-read=. --allow-write=.build --allow-run=tree-sitter scripts/tree-sitter.ts check

check:c.description: Run clang-format, GCC and clang with strict warnings, both static analyzers and clang-tidy

check:shell.description: Run shellcheck, with every optional check, on every shell script

check:queries.description: Compile every generated query against its grammar

check:fixtures.description: Assemble every fixture with the real toolchains and parse it without errors

test:unit.description: Run the unit, highlight, parse-tree, typing, structure and performance tests

corpus.description: Compose each grammar's corpus tests from test/corpus

test:corpus.description: Compose the corpus tests and run them for all five grammars
test:corpus.command: deno task corpus && deno run --allow-read=. --allow-run=tree-sitter scripts/tree-sitter.ts test

sanitize.description: Run the corpus tests and fuzzing against parsers built with ASan and UBSan
sanitize.command: deno task corpus && deno run --allow-read=.,/usr/lib64 --allow-write=.build --allow-run scripts/sanitize.ts

bench.description: Benchmark parsing, editing and queries for every grammar

zed:qa.description: Run the docs/qa.md checks in Zed; start it with scripts/zed, which provides Zed and a display

test.description: Run every check except the sanitizers
test.command: deno fmt --check && deno task lint && deno task check:types && deno task check:generated && deno task test:unit && deno task check:c && deno task check:shell && deno task test:corpus && deno task check:queries && deno task check:fixtures
